title: The Court and Tribunal Fees (Miscellaneous Amendments) (Change of coming into force) Order 2026
summary: The Court and Tribunal Fees (Miscellaneous Amendments) Order 2026 (S.I. 2026/642) (“the 2026 Fees Order”) amends the following instruments relating to court and tribunal fees—

title: The Animals (Scientific Procedures) Act 1986 (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations restate, revoke and replace assimilated law relating to animals used in scientific research, maintaining the current legislative framework by consolidating the provisions into the Animals (Scientific Procedures) Act 1986 (c. 14) (“the ASPA”).

title: The Airports Slot Allocation (Alleviation of Usage Requirements) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations are made in exercise of the power in section 14(3) of the Retained EU Law (Revocation and Reform) Act 2023 (c. 28) (“the 2023 Act”). These Regulations amend Council Regulation (EEC) No 95/93 of 18 January 1993 on common rules for the allocation of slots at United Kingdom airports (“the Slot Regulation”) to make provision about the calculation of airport slot usage for the 2026 summer and winter scheduling periods.

title: The English Devolution and Community Empowerment Act 2026 (Commencement No. 1 and Saving) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations are the first commencement regulations under the English Devolution and Community Empowerment Act 2026 (c. 23).

title: The Environmental Delivery Plans (Appropriate Prioritisation) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations set out how Natural England should prioritise different types of conservation measures when preparing or considering requesting an amendment to an Environmental Delivery Plan (“EDP”) under Part 3 of the Planning and Infrastructure Act 2025 (c. 34).

title: The Higher Education (Freedom of Speech) Act 2023 (Commencement No. 4) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations are the fourth commencement regulations made under the Higher Education (Freedom of Speech) Act 2023 (c. 16) (“the 2023 Act”). They bring into force the provisions of the 2023 Act relating to a free speech complaints scheme listed in regulation 2 on 1st September 2026 and the provision relating to mandatory conditions relating to freedom of speech listed in regulation 3 on 1st April 2027.

title: The Combined Authorities (Mayoral Elections) (Amendment) Order 2026
summary: The Combined Authorities (Mayoral Elections) Order 2017 (S.I. 2017/67, “the 2017 Order”) makes provision for the conduct of elections of combined authority mayors and combined county authority mayors.
